name: post-training-data-quality-rules
tokenizer: lowercase, runs of a to z and 0 to 9 (Learn tokenizer)

rules.name: placeholder_output
rules.condition: at least 1 output token and every output token in placeholder_tokens

rules.name: url_in_instruction
rules.condition: instruction tokens contain any of url_tokens

rules.name: repeated_token_dominance
rules.condition: output at least dominance_min_tokens and most common output token share over dominance_threshold

rules.name: missing_provenance
rules.condition: source empty or license empty or synthetic flag is not true

rules.name: exact_duplicate_in_set
rules.condition: Learn dedup_key already seen earlier in set order
